requirements.evidence: Linear 3-cell build (piece:0,0,0; piece:1,0,0; piece:0,-1,0) ~260mm long, narrow single-row footprint fits windowsill; drained bins allow watering; open top for sunlight.
Three drained full-depth bins (bin:0,-1,0, bin:0,0,0, bin:1,0,0) each filled with soil and planted: basil-young (prop:1), mint-young (prop:2), parsley-young (prop:3).

finish.summary: Built compact 3-cell linear planter with three drained bins, each filled with soil and planted with a young herb (basil, mint, parsley) — suitable for a sunny kitchen windowsill.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Sunny windowsill, three herbs — building you a kitchen-ready planter.
